summary: BUG-151: Dashboard "Reservations · last 30 days" shows 0 ("down 100%") - the 18 reservations made in the last 30 days are left out because they are cancelled
description:
Module: Insights > Dashboard | Tabs: Overview, Sales | Type: Wrong data | Severity: High
Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the Dashboard (24 Nov 2026).
2. Read "Reservations · last 30 days" and the Highlights.
3. Compare with Reservation (all statuses): 21 reservations in total; 000004-000021 (18 reservations) were made between 18 and 24 Nov 2026 and are Cancelled.
Actual result: "Reservations · last 30 days 0, -100% vs previous 30 days" and the highlight "Reservations are down 100% - 0 in the last 30 days against 3 before". Cancelled reservations are not counted.
Expected result: cancelled reservations count too (product owner, 24 Nov 2026) - the card should show 18 for the last 30 days, and the percentage / highlight follow from that.
Environment: STAGE https://erp.nexgenpilot.com (company sb, Chrome), build of 24 Nov 2026 | Bug report ID: BUG-151

Steps to reproduce:

summary: BUG-155: Dashboard Contracts shows contract dates without the year ("Summer 2026 · 24 Oct – 23 Oct") - looks like it ends before it starts
description:
Module: Insights > Dashboard | Tab: Contracts | Type: UI | Severity: Low
Steps to reproduce:
1. Dashboard > Contracts, sections "Drafts" and "Recently rolled over".
Actual result: dates have no year - "Summer 2026 · 24 Oct – 23 Oct", "testing · 09 Nov – 08 Nov", "actions copy · 20 Nov – 19 Nov" (the contract runs 24 Oct 2026 - 23 Oct 2027). A one-year contract reads as if it ends before it starts.
Expected result: the year is shown ("24 Oct 2026 – 23 Oct 2027") - the same fix that was made in the Contracts list (BUG-101).
Environment: STAGE https://erp.nexgenpilot.com (company sb, Chrome), build of 24 Nov 2026 | Bug report ID: BUG-155
